findings.message: 2 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "A seasonal special. Ask what’s on tonight." above "Yelp Top 100, 2025"; "A seasonal special. Ask what’s on tonight." above "SF Gate Best of the Bay"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The margins differ: 32px on the left, 57px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 14958px of nothing between: "Yelp Top 100, 2024"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: 2 of 12 desktop screens are almost empty ground (under 20% of the screen holds text, a picture or a colour field): screens 2, 3.
findings.fix: An empty screen is a rest only once per page. Elsewhere it means the section is underbuilt: set its content larger, give it the full information, put it on a colour field, or cut it.

findings.message: 2 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 620px at 8660px; 596px at 4592px (the screen is 1024px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: 1 large-set statement(s) run past 4 lines at 390px: "Legend says Shakespeare spent his lost y…" → 5 lines at 22px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Much Ado" (screen 11, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.
